frozen_by: worker B (parameter sweeps), Voice Optimization Program

reference.provenance: 0-15s of the same longer recording used for the 18s/39s trials; ends on a complete sentence ("...interconnect more APIs.")
reference.ref_text: Using these will explore how these pieces fit together, where they overlap, where they conflict and how they can be organized into a constitutional architecture built around replay truth. The goal is to interconnect more APIs.

alignment.method: faster-whisper forced alignment (word timestamps), carrier-word end detection

trim_logic.primary: cut_carrier_aligned: resample generation to 16k mono, whisper word timestamps, find leading word matching 'okay' (punctuation-stripped, case-insensitive); cut at word_end + 30ms; apply 15ms linear fade-in; rewrite WAV with correct header. Carrier word must end between 0.1s and 3.0s or the primary path is skipped.
trim_logic.fallback: trim_carrier: longest contiguous sub -42dB run between 0.3s and 2.5s (50ms frames); cut 30% into that run; 15ms fade-in. Fail-safe no-op when no >=150ms quiet run found.
trim_logic.fail_safe: if neither path applies, file is left untouched (never a destructive guess)

depth_pitch.where_set: voice-studio/app.py line 104 (data.get('pitch', -1.5)), clamped to [-4.0, 2.0]; applied post-generation via pitch_shift_file (phase-vocoder time stretch + resample)
depth_pitch.note: the gen_local() engine path (voice-studio/engines/local_qwen.py) does NOT apply pitch shift; the Studio app applies it after generation. Parameter sweep generations use the engine path: carrier + /clone + alignment trim, NO pitch shift.

service.app_py: /app/app.py (1567 lines, no git repo inside container)
service.endpoint: POST /clone (multipart: reference_audio wav file, form fields text / ref_text / language)

generation_parameters_in_effect.source: model snapshot generation_config.json (/app/models/.../snapshots/fd4b254389122332181a7c3db7f27e918eec64e3/generation_config.json); the /clone endpoint passes NO sampling kwargs, so qwen_tts Qwen3TTSModel._merge_generate_kwargs resolves user(None) -> generate_config.json -> hard defaults. generate_config.json is present, so its values win.

mismatch_vs_official_defaults: NONE. Effective production parameters equal the official Qwen defaults exactly (confirmed at three layers: hard defaults in qwen_tts_model.py _merge_generate_kwargs, model generation_config.json, and the /clone call path which forwards no overrides).
sweep_note: The /clone endpoint accepts no sampling parameters, so sweeps cannot run through production /clone without changing production code (not permitted). Sweep generations run inside the qwen3-tts-service container against the same loaded model weights via Qwen3TTSModel.generate_voice_clone with explicit sampling kwargs, keeping the request shape identical (carrier-prefixed text, same ref audio, same ref_text, ICL mode, language=English). CPU device is used to avoid GPU contention with the running production service; the ONLY deliberate difference from production is device (cpu vs cuda) plus the single swept parameter.
